entities.name: Khwaja Abu Nasr Parsa Shrine
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Shrine of Khawaja Abu Nasr Parsa is a mausoleum dedicated to the Naqshbandi mystic and religious teacher, Khwaja Abu Nasr Parsa, located in Balkh, Afghanistan. Today it is part of the Green Mosque complex.
